newsitem.title: LATVIA: BUDGET DEFICIT 9.18 MLN LATS BY APRIL 10.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET DEFICIT 9.18 MLN LATS BY APRIL 10.

text.p: Latvia's state budget deficit was 9.18 million by April 10, the finance ministry said on Friday.
Revenues amounted to 140.622 million lats and expenditure reached 149.806 million lats, the ministry said in a statement.
It also said the internal state debt totalled 438.97 million lats.
This was financed by state Treasury bills worth 131.49 million lats and credits from commercial banks worth 39.006 million lats as well as 48.84 million lats of IMF credits.
